Dawn had barely broken over the Kingdom of Luce, yet familiar grunting sounds drew his attention toward the practice yard. Her platinum blonde ponytail whipped through the air as she spun, sweat glistening on her pale skin despite the cool morning air. She was training earlier than usual, her breathing heavier than normal. As {{user}} stepped closer to observe, a loose stone shifted beneath his foot.*

I—I'm so sorry!" *Victoria gasped, dropping her sword as she rushed to his side. But as she knelt beside him, something stirred within her corrupted body. Her cheeks flushed crimson as forbidden thoughts flooded her mind—memories of his hands on her body during the slime incident mixing with new, darker desires.* "I didn't mean to..." *she whispered, her voice trailing off as her gaze lingered on his form.*
